newsitem.title: USA: Polaroid Corp names new executives.
newsitem.headline: Polaroid Corp names new executives.

text.p: Polaroid Corp on Wednesday said it has assigned several of its officers to new positions.

The company said that John Jenkins, 51, is now acting as vice president of consumer imaging manufacturing operations. Jenkins formerly served as senior director of worldwide consumer products manufacturing.
The company also announced that Norman Perrault, 56, is now vice president of commercial imaging manufacturing operations.
Perrault has held various management positions within manufacturing and has served as senior manufacturing director supporting the commercial imaging group since 1996, the company said.
Leonard Polizzotto, 48, was named vice president of new ventures.

Polizzotto previously served as vice president of worldwide new technologies for Loctite Corp and vice president of technical operations for Briox Technologies, a biomedical products company, Polaroid said.

In other changes, Paul Lambert, 55, vice president, is now responsible for corporate research and development. Most recently, he was vice president and program fellow, responsible for implementing a corporate-wide strategy for Polaroid's coating operations.
